info.name: FoodLoop API
info.description:
Checks for the FoodLoop API, including the negative tests for the business rules
(over-allocation, wrong role, invalid status changes, duplicate requests and runs).

How to run:
1. In backend/: npm run seed, then npm start (API on http://localhost:5000).
2. Import this file into Postman (or Thunder Client: Collections > Import).
3. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.
   The requests depend on each other: earlier ones save tokens and ids
   into collection variables that later ones use.

The run creates its own listing ("Postman Test Pulao"), so it needs only the
seeded logins. It does change data (requests, a delivered run), so run
npm run seed again before a demo.

Command line: npx newman run postman/FoodLoop.postman_collection.json
